plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.226-228. A combined concentration in history and political science is not available within the liberal studies major, as printed.

courses.title: Career / Internship course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 1-8 credits as printed: CLD 3100 Experiencing Career & Life Directions; HIS/POL 3800 Internship. Recorded at the 1-credit minimum: the catalog printed total of 41 for this major assumes 1 credit from this slot.

courses.title: Western Civilization course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: HIS 1150 Western Civilization I; HIS 1160 Western Civilization II.

courses.title: American History course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: HIS 1210 Colonial & Revolutionary America; HIS 1220 Nineteenth Century America; HIS 1230 Modern America; HIS 1240 Contemporary America.

courses.title: History / Political Science courses (choose two)
courses.choice_note: Choose two of these courses, 8 credits as printed: HPS 3120 Revolution; HPS 3320 The Civil War and Reconstruction; HPS 3360 Nations and Nationalism; HPS 3380 Middle East History, Politics, & Thought.

courses.title: Political Science course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: POL 1115 Political Ideas; POL 2200 Non-Western Politics and Thought.

courses.title: Political Science course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: POL 2110 International Relations; POL 2120 Introduction to Comparative Politics.

courses.title: HIS/HPS Elective (2000+ course)
courses.choice_note: HIS/HPS Elective, 2000+ course, 4 credits as printed (block subtotal; no individual elective course is listed). Note: HON 2110 may substitute for a 2000-level HIS course, as printed.

courses.title: HPS/POL Elective (2000+ course)
courses.choice_note: HPS/POL Elective, 2000+ course, 4 credits as printed (block subtotal; no individual elective course is listed).
